title: homebox-mcp values
description: Strict: a typo in a values file should fail the render, not be silently ignored and leave you wondering why a setting had no effect.

tag.description: Empty means the chart's appVersion. Pin it to upgrade deliberately rather than whenever the chart is republished.

url.description: Base URL WITHOUT /api - the server appends /api/v1 itself.

existingSecret.description: Required. The token is never a literal in values: it would end up in a values file, in git, and in `helm get values` output.

timeout.description: Deadline for an ordinary request to HomeBox, body included. A Go duration such as 30s.

issuerUrl.description: access-roster's own URL, exactly as it appears in a token's `iss`.

resourceUrl.description: This server's own EXTERNAL URL: the RFC 8707 resource indicator a client names, and the audience access-roster mints for it. Must match this resource's id in access-roster's policy, byte for byte.

scope.description: Advertised in the PRM's scopes_supported and the 401 challenge's scope; never checked by this server. Empty omits both fields rather than advertising an empty list.

deploymentAnnotations.description: Annotations on the Deployment itself. Reloader reads them here, not on the pod template.

maxBytes.description: Largest file an upload link accepts, in bytes. Raise HomeBox's HBOX_WEB_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE (MiB) with it.

ttl.description: How long a link stays valid, 1m to 24h.

timeout.description: How long one whole upload may take, 10s to 6h.
